# SheetJS Community Edition

`xlsx.mini.min.js` is the standalone mini build, version 0.20.3.

Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.mini.min.js

Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/

License: Apache 2.0, included in `SheetJS-LICENSE.txt`.

The file is hosted with the app and cached for offline use. No runtime CDN or
build pipeline is needed. The mini build supports our XLSX input; legacy XLS
and other spreadsheet formats are intentionally outside the app's input format.

Downloaded size: 279,523 bytes. Local gzip measurement: 86,859 bytes.
